SELECT qhse.id, qhse.type, qhse.quality_type, qhse.id remarkid, qhse.remark remark, qhse.duty_id productUserId, qhse.type 'questionType', qhse.quality_type 'qualityType', qhse.duty_id duty_id, report.user_id, report.product_id, report.inspect_report_number reportNumber, process.process_id process_id, ta.serial_number artifactSerialNumber, productuser.`name` productUserName, inspectuser.`name` inspectionUserName, project.id 'project.id', project.serial_number 'project.serial_number', project.short_name 'project.short_name', project.`name` 'project.name', project.`mode` 'project.type', pro.`name` processName, task.bool_one_code 'boolOneCode', COUNT(*) quantity, qhse.create_time createTime FROM mes_building_qhse qhse LEFT JOIN mes_building_qhse_inspection_link link ON qhse.id = link.qhse_id and link.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report report ON link.inspection_report_id = report.id and report.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_qhse_team_report qr ON report.id = qr.inspection_team_report_id and qr.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process process ON report.task_process_id = process.id and process.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON task.id = process.task_id and task.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON process.project_id = project.id and project.bool_delete_enum=0
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON report.product_id = ta.id AND ta.bool_delete_enum=0
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON report.product_id = ta.id AND ta.bool_delete_enum=0
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON report.product_id = ta.id AND ta.bool_delete_enum=0
LEFT JOIN mes_building_process pro ON process.process_id = pro.id AND pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user productuser ON qhse.duty_id = productuser.id AND productuser.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN sys_user inspectuser ON qr.user_id = inspectuser.id AND inspectuser.bool_delete_enum=0
qhse.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND process.id IN ( SELECT id FROM `mes_building_task_process` WHERE groups_id IN
#{groups}
)
AND process.task_id IN
#{ids}

AND DATE(qr.create_time)<=DATE(#{endDate})
GROUP BY qhse.id, qhse.type, qhse.quality_type, qhse.id, qhse.remark, qhse.duty_id, qhse.type, qhse.quality_type, qhse.duty_id, qhse.create_time, report.user_id, inspectuser.name, report.product_id, report.inspect_report_number, process.process_id, ta.serial_number, project.id, project.serial_number, project.short_name, project.`name`, project.`mode`, pro.`name` , task.bool_one_code

SELECT task.project_id 'project.id', task.monomer_id 'monomer.id', task.area_id 'areaDetail.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`name` 'areaDetail.name', DATE( a.create_time ) date, a.process_id, process.`name` process_name, CASE a.task_type_enum WHEN 2 THEN artifact.`name` ELSE enclosure.`name` END NAME, CASE a.task_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN machine_part.serial_number WHEN 2 THEN artifact.serial_number WHEN 16 THEN assemble.serial_number ELSE enclosure.serial_number END serial_number,
IFNULL( sum( a.inspection_quantity ), 0 ) inspection_quantity
IFNULL( sum( b.qhse_quantity ), 0 ) qhse_quantity
FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_qhse_team_report b ON a.id = b.inspection_team_report_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON a.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON a.task_id = task.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = task.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = task.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON pd.id = task.area_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON a.product_id = artifact.id LEFT JOIN tech_assemble assemble ON a.product_id = assemble.id LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure enclosure ON a.product_id = enclosure.id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part machine_part ON a.product_id = machine_part.id
AND task.project_id in
#{projectId}
AND task.project_id=#{projectId}
AND DATE(a.create_time)>=DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(a.create_time)<=DATE(#{endDate})
AND a.task_type_enum&#{productType}
AND cp.`name` like CONCAT('%', #{projectName},'%')
AND ( artifact.serial_number LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{serialNumber}, '%' ) OR assemble.serial_number LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{serialNumber}, '%' ) OR enclosure.serial_number LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{serialNumber}, '%' ) OR machine_part.serial_number LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{serialNumber}, '%' ) )
AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND qhse_quantity>0
GROUP BY task.project_id, task.monomer_id, task.area_id, cp.`name`, cp.short_name, cp.serial_number, pm.`name`, pd.`name`, DATE ( a.create_time ), a.process_id, process.`name`, a.task_type_enum, machine_part.serial_number, artifact.serial_number, assemble.serial_number, enclosure.serial_number, artifact.`name`, enclosure.`name`
